Coach Guide
How to manage your program listing, discover recruits, track interested players, and connect with student-athletes.
collegerugbyportal.com

Getting Started

College Rugby Portal gives coaches a centralized platform to manage their program's presence, discover potential recruits, and communicate directly with interested student-athletes. Over 900 programs are listed, and players across the country use the portal to research and connect with programs.

Getting Coach Access

1
Visit collegerugbyportal.com and sign in with Google or email/password.
2
If your email matches a Head Coach contact in the system, you'll automatically receive coach access.
3
If not, contact us through the Submit Program Info page and a portal administrator will grant access and assign your program.
Tip: Make sure the email you sign in with matches the coaching email listed for your program. This is the fastest way to get automatic access.

Install the App

Add the portal to your home screen for quick access:

  • iPhone: Open in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen."
  • Android: Open in Chrome, tap the menu, then "Add to Home Screen."

It launches fullscreen like a native app with push notifications for new messages and player interest.

Your Coach Dashboard

The My Program tab in the bottom navigation is your home base. It has three sections:

Interested Players

This tab shows every player who has favorited your program. When a student-athlete saves your program to their favorites, they appear here automatically. For each player you can see:

  • Name, position, secondary position
  • Graduation year, GPA
  • City, state, current club
  • Height and weight
  • Highlight video link (if provided)

Use the search bar and filters to narrow by position, graduation year, or name. Click any player to view their full profile or send them a message.

Tip: You receive an email and push notification whenever a new player expresses interest in your program. Respond quickly to make a strong impression.

My Recruits

Build your personal recruit board by adding players you're interested in. This is your private list that only you can see.

1
From the Interested Players tab or the Player Directory, tap the Save button on any player's card.
2
The player appears in your My Recruits tab.
3
Rate recruits with 1-5 stars to prioritize your list.
4
Add notes to each recruit (e.g., "Strong ball carrier, needs to see game film" or "Contacted 3/15, waiting for response").

Filter and sort your recruits by rating, position, graduation year, or name. Recruits are sorted by star rating by default so your top prospects are always at the top.

Edit Program

Keep your program's listing up to date so players see accurate information:

Program Info

Update your school website URL, rugby-specific website, program logo, scholarship availability, school-funded status, and program description/notes.

Coach Contacts

Manage your coaching staff listing. Add, edit, or remove coaches with their name, title, and email. The Head Coach is always displayed first on your program page.

Tip: Programs with a complete listing (logo, website, scholarship info, and coach contacts) get significantly more views from players. Add a program description that highlights what makes your program unique.

Player Directory

The Players tab in the bottom navigation gives you access to every student-athlete who has made their profile public on the portal.

Searching for Recruits

  • Search: Find players by name, city, state, club, position, or high school
  • Position filter: Narrow to specific positions (e.g., Flyhalf, Hooker, Flanker)
  • Graduation year: Focus on a specific recruiting class
  • State filter: Find players in your region

Each player card shows their key stats at a glance. Click to see their full profile, including achievements, preferred regions, and highlight video. From there you can save them to your recruit list or send a direct message.

Messaging Players

The messaging system lets you communicate directly with prospective student-athletes.

1
From a player's profile in the Interested Players tab or Player Directory, tap Message.
2
Type your message and send. The player receives an email notification and a push notification (if enabled).
3
All conversations are in the Messages tab. Unread messages show a badge count.
Tip: Players are more likely to respond when you reference something specific from their profile, like their position, club team, or highlight video. A personalized first message goes a long way.

Notifications

Stay on top of recruiting activity with three types of notifications:

Player Interest

A student-athlete favorited your program. Check the Interested Players tab to see their profile.

New Message

A player sent you a message. Tap to go directly to the conversation.

Push Notifications

Enable push notifications when prompted so you receive alerts even when the app is closed. You'll also receive email notifications for new messages and player interest.

The bell icon in the header shows your unread notification count. Tap it to see all recent activity.

Program Visibility

Your program page is what players see when researching your school. Here's what's displayed:

  • School info: Name, logo, location, school website, rugby website
  • Academics: GPA, SAT, acceptance rate, enrollment, US News rank, tuition
  • Rugby: National ranking, conference, league, scholarship status, school-funded status
  • Contacts: Coaching staff names, titles, and email addresses
  • Program notes: Your description of the program

Players can also compare your program side-by-side with up to 2 other programs, seeing academics, tuition, and rugby info at a glance.

Submitting Updates

If your program info needs updating (new coach, conference change, scholarship status, etc.), use the Submit Program Info page under the More menu. An administrator will review and apply changes, or you can update most fields directly from the Edit Program tab in your dashboard.

Quick Reference

Bottom Navigation Bar

Programs - Browse all programs | My Program - Your dashboard | Players - Player directory | Messages - Conversations | More - Conferences, Leagues, Rankings, About

Recruiting Workflow

1. Check Interested Players for new interest → 2. Browse Player Directory for prospects → 3. Save recruits and rate them → 4. Message top prospects → 5. Add notes to track conversations

Program Checklist

For maximum visibility: upload your logo, add your rugby website, list scholarship/funding status, write program notes, and keep coach contacts current.
